definitions.explanation: The act of starting or launching a computer, application, or system. Used broadly for any device or software that powers on or initializes.

examples.japanese: パソコンを{起動|きどう}する。
アプリの{起動|きどう}が{遅|おそ}くなった。
examples.english: The app has become slow to start up.

examples.japanese: {電源|でんげん}ボタンを{押|お}してもパソコンが{起動|きどう}しないときは、サポートに{連絡|れんらく}してください。
examples.english: If the computer won't start even when you press the power button, please contact support.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used with する to form a verb meaning "to start up" or "to boot." Frequently appears in computing contexts but also applies to machines, engines, and systems in general.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- パソコンを{起動|きどう}する (to start up a computer)
- アプリを{起動|きどう}する (to launch an app)
- {起動|きどう}が{遅|おそ}い (slow to start)
- {起動|きどう}{時|じ} (at startup)
- {再|さい}{起動|きどう}する (to restart)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {軌道|きどう}: orbit; track — a homophone with a completely different meaning
- {起動|きどう} vs {再|さい}{起動|きどう}: {起動|きどう} is initial startup, while {再起動|さいきどう} is restarting

cross_references.notes: Same reading きどう but means orbit or track
